Package org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.dcat.jsonld

package org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.dcat.jsonld
A small reader for JSON-LD documents. It expands the terms used in a document into full IRIs and flattens the nested nodes into a graph of nodes that can be looked up by identifier. It supports the features of JSON-LD that are used in DCAT descriptions (embedded contexts, prefixes, term definitions, keyword aliases, value objects, language maps, lists and sets). Contexts are never retrieved from the network: a document that refers to a remote context is read using the standard prefixes and term names of the DCAT vocabulary.
